summary: You pick Education Data Science or Learning Design and Technology. Education Data Science is at least 20 courses and 51 units: the core sequence, two statistics courses, three education foundation courses approved by the program director and moved in by hand, and two courses in each of three of the five specialization tracks, with at least 17 letter-graded units, 25 units at the 200 level and 30 EDUC units. Learning Design and Technology is at least 45 units: the EDUC 229 sequence, two quarters of the internship workshop (at most 9 internship units count), and the methods, design, learning and technology courses with their unit minimums, with at least 23 units at the 200 level, 30 EDUC units and 15 letter-graded units. Your advisor checks the 3.0 GPA, the LDT portfolio and master's project, and the LDT summer unit load.
